text:
Messengers in the night announced what we did not hear.

A search was made beneath the howl of light.

Someone wanted to stop the advance of the gloved hands

that strangled innocence.


And if they hid in the house of my blood,

how do I not crawl toward the beloved

who dies behind my tenderness?

Why do I not flee

and pursue myself with knives

and delirium myself?


Every instant has been woven of death.

I devour fury like an idiot angel

invaded by weeds

that keep him from remembering the color of the sky.


But they and I know

that the sky has the color of dead childhood.

translation.title: The Motionless Dance
translation.editorial_note: The invented reflexive force of me deliro is echoed by the deliberately strange delirium myself.
